acceptance: GitTreeTicketStore.load() reads all directory-store shards in a single git cat-file --batch invocation (verified by spawn count in tests) and uses NUL-safe buffer parsing in git-tree.mjs and rail-existence.mjs.
DirectoryTicketStore and TicketService expose loadOne(id) single-shard lookup and TicketService memoizes ticketHash during planning without changing snapshot or plan hashes.

packages/tickets/package.json exports ./lib/{canonical,durability,lock,manifest-primitives}.mjs while staying strictly zero-dependency; tickets/lib/lock.mjs supports stale-lock recovery via same-host PID/start-time liveness and tickets/lib/durability.mjs refuses symlinks on durableWrite/writeFileAtomic.

packages/ticket-prune/lib/store.mjs delegates locking and atomic staging to @adlc/tickets, scripts/test/workspace-deps-declared.test.mjs enforces acyclicity across all packages/*, Cursor bundles are rebuilt in lockstep, and full npm run preflight passes.
body: Implement Wave 2 T-P14b: (1) Replace the N+1 git show loop in GitTreeTicketStore.load() with a single git cat-file --batch stream, add loadOne(id) single-shard lookup on DirectoryTicketStore/TicketService, memoize ticketHash per pass in TicketService, and switch git-tree.mjs and rail-existence.mjs to NUL-safe buffer splitting; (2) Export ./lib/{canonical,durability,lock,manifest-primitives}.mjs from packages/tickets/package.json, upgrade tickets/lib/{lock,durability}.mjs with stale-lock recovery (pid+procStartTimeOf) and symlink-safe atomic durability, delegate packages/ticket-prune/lib/store.mjs and packages/core/lib/{primitives,ledger}.mjs downward where appropriate while keeping @adlc/core -> @adlc/tickets strictly one-way, add workspace dependency acyclicity assertion in scripts/test/workspace-deps-declared.test.mjs, and rebuild Cursor bundles.
title: Wave 2: GitTreeTicketStore git cat-file --batch, loadOne, NUL-safe paths, and zero-dep @adlc/tickets leaf primitives (T-P14b)
